run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the maximum removal count from a sorted array given n elements
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets and print the number of successful results
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which sorts an array and greedily counts elements greater than or equal to cumulative sum
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that sorts input array and iterates counting valid removals up to n
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to avoid mutating the input array by sorting a copy instead
